Team — forwarding Nebula's RFP + our initial summary. They asked for a pilot commercial + SOW by week of Apr 12.

Proposal options (high level) I sketched in the attached calc: internal_model_calc.csv
1) Pilot bundle (recommended for RFP window):
   - 3-node starter (node entitlements) + 3 operator licenses
   - Platform fee: one-time starter activation fee $35k amortized over 12 months on conversion to enterprise OR credited if they commit to enterprise within 90 days
   - Observability retention credit for 90 days (waive additional retention cost for pilot)
   - Support: Enhanced (08:00-20:00) with optional paid 24x7 on-call during pilot at reduced rate
   - Discount: 25% off list on platform fee for pilot (conditional on signature within procurement window)

2) Enterprise ramp (if they commit to 12+ month enterprise contract within 90 days):
   - Platform fee: amortized across committed term; per-customer model with per-site node entitlements for additional sites
   - Operator license: billed per-seat for admin/control plane; site operator pool options available
   - Support tiers: Gold (SLA 4h P1, operational handover), Platinum (1h P1, archived telemetry retention 1 year, quarterly reviews)
   - Credits: Implementation credit schedule tied to milestone acceptance (pilot completion, production cutover)

Questions for finance/legal:
- Is the 25% pilot platform fee reduction acceptable as a standard promotional concession? (Priyom please advise on margin impact)
- Naomi, can we permit the credit to be applied retroactively on conversion (instead of up-front waiver) per standard T&Cs?

I think we should aim to present a single-page pilot commercial + a 2-page SOW that clarifies scope and data handling. Marissa, can you draft the SOW template and include the observability credit clause?
